source: Designer MVP rules sheet (Oct 8 2026), section 5 'Expected timeline' (designer-sim estimates, not real-sim results) and section 7 step 2 (15 s tolerance). Scenario data/balance/scenarios/columbia_gorge_100mi_mvp.json on main b9e53fc, Normal difficulty.

lines.baseline: Compact takes The Dalles at 8:30. The Remnant keeps its third motor rifle battalion at home.
lines.remnant_commit: The Remnant commits its third motor rifle battalion to The Dalles, takes it at 8:02, builds the forward depot at node 614 and drives on Hood River.

targets.description: First Compact battalion arrives in The Dalles (territory 4, key 0x10000000B3787512). Manpower-gated, so the same in both lines.
Compact completes the capture of The Dalles (baseline line: the Remnant does not commit a third rifle battalion).
Remnant completes the capture of The Dalles (commit line: the Remnant commits its third motor rifle battalion).
Remnant Tier II research completes (autoResearch tier2, notBeforeTick 1200, researchTicks 1800).
Second raised remnant_mech_battalion completes; the strike group (3 armour + 2 mech + 2 rifles) is ready.
Compact militia completion from the rules sheet 5 row 'Compact militia / AT' (MVP estimate 3:15). See the open question in docs/design/mvp-acceptance.md.
First raised compact_at_battalion completes (rules sheet 5 row 'Compact militia / AT', MVP estimate 4:45).
Remnant forward supply_depot at road node 614 (The Dalles) completes. The sheet gives this as 'about 10:39' on the commit line.
Remnant strike group arrives at Hood River after the 44.4 road-mile tracked drive.
Remnant captures the Compact HQ holding at Hood River: Remnant win. Lower bound against a passive Compact with no counterattack.
